item.title: Warming Shelter to open Saturday for overnight guests
item.description: A temporary overnight cold-weather shelter in Wilmington will reopen Saturday, Feb. 7, to provide warmth and safety for people experiencing homelessness during some of the area’s coldest nights.

item.title: The hearing for a top Columbus County School official gets postponed to a later date
item.description: Hearing date for Columbus County school official, Robert Adam Thompson, was postponed for a later date in the year.

item.title: NCDOT responds after several complaints about trash piling up in Leland
item.description: After several complaints of trashing piling in Leland, NCDOT responds with a statement on their goals

item.title: Social media complaint raises concern for Novant Health cleanliness; Novant responds
item.description: Novant Health New Hanover Regional Medical Center responded to a complaint posted on social media which alleged the conditions at one of its facilities for patients was deplorable.

item.title: After life-saving heart transplant, Brunswick Co. woman advocates for heart health
item.description: February is American Heart Month and one Brunswick County woman is raising awareness about heart disease after undergoing a heart transplant.

item.title: New Hanover County investigates two missing persons amid Savannah Guthrie spotlight
item.description: While the disappearance of Savannah Guthrie’s mother has garnered national attention, the New Hanover County Sheriff's Office is currently working two missing person cases reported just this morning.

item.title: Texas Roadhouse supports tinnitus awareness with special fundraiser
item.description: Next week starts Tinnitus Awareness Week -- a condition characterized by the perception of noise like a ringing or buzzing in both ears.

item.title: UNCW falls to William & Mary 85-78, swept in season series
item.description: If any team was going to be a thorn in the side of UNCW men's basketball, William & Mary showed they might be that after handing the Seahawks an 85-78 home loss on Thursday.

item.title: US Army Corps of Engineers address pause in Carolina and Kure Beach renourishment project
item.description: Colonel Brad Morgan with the Army Corps of Engineers stated that this pause was always planned, but it may not have been communicated effectively to the public before the project began.

item.title: NHC Planning Board approves rezoning for Carolina Beach Rd development opposed by nearby residents
item.description: The proposed development would be built on just over an acre of land located along Carolina Beach Road between Little Pony Trail and Red Lighthouse Lane.
